abstract:
BACKGROUND: The differential impact of negative resection margins that are > 1 mm (R0) or ≤ 1 mm (R0close) compared to positive (R1) margins on overall survival (OS) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is unclear in the modern era of chemotherapy administration. Historically, R0close margins were shown to have a negative impact on OS compared to R0, but these data predate wide adoption of the current multiagent cytotoxic treatment regimens and neoadjuvant treatment approaches.
METHODS: We analyzed patients with PDAC undergoing pancreatectomy from April 2014 to April 2024 at a high-volume academic center. OS was assessed via Kaplan-Meier method, log-rank test, and Cox proportional hazard model to adjust for covariates.
RESULTS: A total of 514 pancreatectomies were identified. Of 256 patients with PDAC, margin assessment revealed R0, R0close, and R1 margins occurred in 62.9%, 29.3%, and 7.8% respectively. Overall, 93% of patients received systemic chemotherapy. Median OS was 48.6 months; 54.6 months for R0, 41.3 months for R0close, and 20.7 months for R1 (P = 0.04). The unadjusted Cox proportional hazard model did not show a significant difference in OS between R0 and R0close margins [hazard ratio (HR) = 1.16, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.80-1.69] but showed a significant difference in OS between R0 and R1 margins (R1: HR = 2.04, 95% CI: 1.16-3.60). The results of the adjusted model incorporating demographic, surgical, and clinicopathologic variables were similar (R0close: HR = 1.09, 95% CI: 0.71-1.67; R1: HR = 1.88, 95% CI: 1.01-3.52).
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing resection for PDAC and treated with multiagent systemic therapy, survival linearly decreased with R0, R0close, and R1 status, with no significant difference between R0 and R0close margins.

절제 단면 상태별 중앙 생존기간은 R0군 54.6개월, R0close군 41.3개월, R1군 20.7개월로 나타났습니다(P=0.04).
다변량 조정을 거친 Cox 비례위험 모델 분석에서 R0close군은 R0군 대비 사망 위험비(HR)가 1.09(95% CI: 0.71-1.67)로 유의미한 생존율 차이를 보이지 않았습니다.
R1 절제군은 R0군에 비해 사망 위험이 유의하게 높았습니다(HR = 1.88, 95% CI: 1.01-3.52).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 현대적인 다제 항암화학요법 체계에서 췌장암 수술 시 절제 단면 상태가 환자의 전체 생존기간(OS)에 미치는 영향을 분석했습니다. 2014년부터 2024년까지 췌장절제술을 받은 췌장관선암(PDAC) 환자 256명을 대상으로 분석을 진행했습니다. 분석 결과, 음성 절제 단면인 R0(>1mm)군과 근접 음성 단면인 R0close(≤1mm)군 사이의 생존율에는 통계적으로 유의미한 차이가 관찰되지 않았습니다. 반면 잔류 암이 남아있는 R1(양성) 절제군은 R0군에 비해 생존율이 현저히 낮았습니다.
title: Association between close margin status and survival in the modern systemic treatment era for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 현대 항암화학요법 시대에서 췌장관선암의 근접 절제 단면 상태와 생존율의 연관성
